reason: Internal tooling / architecture change. No Jira ticket and no product-feature intake. Recorded to satisfy the change-package structure; provide a tracking key or accept as an internal ADR before approval.
summary: Desktop console (Tauri v2, Rust core + web frontend) over the file-based OpenSpec control plane
acceptance_criteria: A desktop console renders the file-based control-plane state (changes, status, approvals, work items, evidence, traceability) from openspec/changes/*/.
The console runs the pinned gate scripts (preflight, validate, create-worktree, bootstrap) via named commands and streams their output and exit status.
The console can stream a headless /opsx:propose and /opsx:apply agent run.
The console is a view/controller only; no governance logic is reimplemented in Rust and the YAML packages + bash scripts remain the single source of truth.
No generic command execution and no push is reachable from the UI; preflight stays fetch-only and Tauri v2 capabilities grant only the named commands.
